description.value: Taseko Lake Lodge is a remote wilderness retreat in BC's Chilcotin region, reachable only by a 3+ hour off-road drive or floatplane transfer from Whistler. The property features deluxe hand-crafted log cabins, a wood-fired sauna and hot tub, and organic gourmet cuisine, with guided experiences including horseback riding, jet boat excursions, and backcountry hiking. It operates under the 'Taseko Adventures' brand and is oriented toward multi-night immersive wilderness stays.

address.value: Taseko Lakes, Cariboo, BC V0L 1W0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully fetched and describes an active remote wilderness lodge in BC's Chilcotin backcountry, with current bookings for 2026 and 2027 retreats, confirming the business is real and open. No cycling, bike storage, or any bike-related amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all bike criteria default to null. The OSM name 'Taseko Lake Lodge' is used internally on the website ('The Taseko Lake Lodge and its charming deluxe log cabins...'), though the operating brand is 'Taseko Adventures' — a minor discrepancy worth noting.
concerns: OSM name is 'Taseko Lake Lodge' but the primary operating brand on the website is 'Taseko Adventures' — the lodge name does appear in website body text so both refer to the same property.
No phone number or civic address available in OSM or on the website.
Property is accessible only via 3+ hours of off-road driving or floatplane from Whistler, limiting practical relevance for most touring cyclists.
No cycling-specific amenities or bike facilities mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable wilderness lodge with active 2026/2027 availability. Extremely remote but a legitimate accommodation stop for cyclists making the Chilcotin backcountry traverse.
enrichment_extras.notes: Adventure packages are all-inclusive (meals, gear, activities). Explorer/cabin-rental option allows self-catered stays. Horse activities paused for 2026; guided wilderness adventures booking from June 2027.
